<h2 id="thingsboard">ThingsBoard</h2>
<h2 id="wath-is-thingsboard-">Wath is ThingsBoard ?</h2>
<p>ThingsBoard &nbsp;is an open-source IoT platform for data collection, processing, visualization, and device management</p>
<p>It enables device connectivity via industry standard IoT protocols - MQTT, CoAP and HTTP and supports both cloud and on-premises deployments. ThingsBoard combines scalability, fault-tolerance and performance so you will never lose your data.</p>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/</a><br>
<a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/install/installation-options/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/install/installation-options/</a><br>
<a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/pe/guides/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/pe/guides/</a></p>
<p>github源码仓库 - <a href="https://github.com/thingsboard/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/thingsboard/</a><br>
前端Vue3 适配 4.2X - <a href="https://gitee.com/oliver225/thingsboard-ui-vue3" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/oliver225/thingsboard-ui-vue3</a><br>
前端Vue3 适配 4.3X - <a href="https://github.com/oliver225/thingsboard-ui-vue3" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/oliver225/thingsboard-ui-vue3</a></p>
<h1 id="主要概念和设计的逻辑">主要概念和设计的逻辑</h1>
<p>跟国内物联网平台都不太一样, 先理清概念关系..</p>
<h3 id="用户关系图">用户关系图</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3723410/202604/3723410-20260416214554433-539741752.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="实体-设备资产关系图">实体-设备/资产关系图</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3723410/202604/3723410-20260416214601829-1554136720.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/device-profiles/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/device-profiles/</a></p>
<h4 id="实体关系说明">实体关系说明</h4>
<p>ThingsBoard 提供用户界面和 REST API，用于在您的物联网应用中配置和管理多种实体类型及其关系。支持的实体包括：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/ui/tenants/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">租户</a></strong>——您可以将租户视为一个独立的商业实体：它是拥有或生产设备和资产的个人或组织；租户可能拥有多个租户管理员用户和数百万客户、设备和资产；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/ui/customers/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">客户</a></strong>——客户也是一个独立的商业实体：购买或使用租户设备和/或资产的个人或组织；客户可能拥有多个用户和数百万台设备和/或资产；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/ui/users/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">用户</a></strong>- 用户可以浏览仪表盘和管理实体；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/ui/devices/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">设备</a></strong>——基本的物联网实体，可以生成遥测数据并处理 RPC 命令。例如，传感器、执行器、开关；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/ui/assets/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">资产</a></strong>——抽象的物联网实体，可能与其他设备和资产相关。例如，工厂、田地、车辆；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/entity-views/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">实体视图</a></strong>- 如果您只想与客户共享部分设备或资产数据，则此视图非常有用；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/alarms/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">警报</a></strong>- 用于识别您的资产、设备或其他实体问题的事件；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/dashboards/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">仪表盘</a></strong>- 可视化您的物联网数据，并通过用户界面控制特定设备；</li>
<li><strong>规则节点</strong>- 用于处理传入消息、实体生命周期事件等的处理单元；</li>
<li><strong>规则链——定义</strong><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rule-engine-2-0/re-getting-started/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">规则引擎</a>中的处理流程。可能包含多个规则节点，并链接到其他规则链；</li>
</ul>
<p>每个实体都支持：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/attributes/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">属性</a></strong>——与实体关联的静态和半静态键值对。例如，序列号、型号、固件版本；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/telemetry/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">时间序列数据</a></strong>——可用于存储、查询和可视化的时间序列数据点。例如，温度、湿度、电池电量；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/entities-and-relations/#relations" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">关系</a></strong>——与其他实体的定向连接。例如，包含、管理、拥有、生产。</li>
</ul>
<p>部分实体支持用户配置文件：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/tenant-profiles/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">租户配置文件</a></strong>- 包含多个租户的通用设置：实体、API 和速率限制等。每个租户在某一时刻都只有一个配置文件。</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/device-profiles/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">设备配置文件</a></strong>- 包含多个设备的通用设置：处理和传输配置等。每个设备在某一时刻只有一个配置文件。<strong>可以理解为配置 产品(定义设备接入平台的配置, 类似 物模型)</strong></li>
<li><strong><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/asset-profiles/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">资产配置文件</a></strong>- 包含多个资产的通用设置：处理配置等。每个资产在某一时刻只有一个配置文件。</li>
</ul>
<p>资产和设备的区别</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>特性</th>
<th>设备 (Device)</th>
<th>资产 (Asset)</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>角色定位</strong></td>
<td>代表物理或虚拟的物联网硬件。</td>
<td>代表具有业务意义的物理或逻辑实体。可以理解为抽象出设备数据的逻辑视图，包括但不限于设备</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>数据产生</strong></td>
<td><strong>可以</strong>产生和上传遥测数据（如温度、湿度）。</td>
<td><strong>本身不产生</strong>遥测数据。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>典型示例</strong></td>
<td>传感器、执行器、网关、智能电表。</td>
<td>建筑物、车辆、工厂、产线、办公室。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="设备与资产关联">设备与资产关联</h3>
<p>接口 - /api/relation<br>
实体统一关联表 - relation</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
  "type": "Contains",
  "additionalInfo": null,
  "typeGroup": "COMMON",
  "from": {
    "entityType": "ASSET",
    "id": "db626fb0-37d1-11f1-b2ba-13123c3d838e"
  },
  "to": { "entityType": "DEVICE", "id": "c0a8b350-37d1-11f1-b2ba-13123c3d838e" }
}
</code></pre>
<h1 id="整体的架构">整体的架构</h1>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/reference/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/reference/</a></p>
<p>[[thingsboard-architecture.svg]]<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3723410/202604/3723410-20260416214622141-1101842293.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="thingsboard-transports">ThingsBoard Transports</h2>
<p>ThingsBoard 提供基于 MQTT、HTTP、CoAP 及 LwM2M 协议的 API，供设备应用程序 / 固件使用。各类协议 API 均由独立的服务端组件实现，隶属于 ThingsBoard「传输层」。其中，MQTT 传输组件还提供网关 API，用于对接可接入多台设备及 / 或传感器的网关设备。</p>
<p>Once the Transport receives the message from device, it is parsed and pushed to durable&nbsp;<a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/reference/#message-queues-are-awesome" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Message Queue</a>. The message delivery is acknowledged to device only after corresponding message is acknowledged by the message queue.<br>
传输层接收到设备上报的消息后(这里是Transports)，会对消息进行解析并推送至持久化消息队列(这里指kafka)。只有当消息队列确认收到相应的消息后，才会向设备确认消息已送达。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>注意一点 如果是非集群模式, 消息上来则是在内存中直接路由。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="thingsboard-core">ThingsBoard Core</h2>
<p>ThingsBoard 核心服务负责处理 REST API 调用与 WebSocket 订阅，同时维护当前活跃设备会话的最新信息，并监控设备在线状态。其底层基于 Actor 模型，为租户、设备等核心实体构建对应的 Actor 实例。平台节点可组建集群，各节点负责处理特定分区的入站消息。</p>
<h2 id="thingsboard-rule-engine">ThingsBoard Rule Engine</h2>
<p>规则引擎是系统的核心组件，负责处理所有入站消息。其底层同样基于 Actor 模型，为规则链、规则节点等核心实体实现对应的 Actor 实例。规则引擎节点可加入集群，每个节点负责处理特定分区的入站消息。</p>
<p>规则引擎订阅消息队列的入站数据流，仅在消息处理完成后才进行消息确认。系统支持多种策略，用于控制消息处理顺序与消息确认条件，详情可参考提交策略与处理策略相关说明。</p>
<p>ThingsBoard 规则引擎支持两种运行模式：共享模式与隔离模式。</p>
<ol>
<li>共享模式下，规则引擎可处理多个租户的消息；</li>
<li>隔离模式下，规则引擎可配置为仅处理特定租户配置下的租户消息。</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="thingsboard-web-ui">ThingsBoard Web UI</h2>
<p>ThingsBoard 提供基于 Express.js 框架开发的轻量组件，用于托管静态 Web UI 资源。该组件为完全无状态设计，可配置项较少。静态 Web UI 包含应用程序打包资源，加载完成后，应用将通过 ThingsBoard 核心服务提供的 REST API 与 WebSocket API 运行。</p>
<h2 id="thingsboard-message-queues">ThingsBoard message queues</h2>
<p>ThingsBoard 支持两类消息队列：Kafka 队列与内存队列。</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Kafka 是一款应用广泛的分布式持久化消息队列系统，专为处理海量数据设计，适用于对高吞吐、容错性与可扩展性有严格要求的生产环境。<br>
[[N_Kafka]]</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>内存队列为轻量、高效、简洁的队列实现，面向测试、小规模部署或开发环境使用。消息存储于内存而非磁盘，优先保证性能而非持久化。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>使用可持久化、可扩展的 Kafka 队列，可使 ThingsBoard 实现<strong>背压控制</strong>与负载均衡。背压机制在流量峰值场景下至关重要。系统针对具体队列实现封装了抽象层，并统一维护两大核心概念：主题（Topic）与主题分区（Topic Partition）。一个主题可配置多个分区。由于多数队列实现不原生支持分区，系统采用 <code>主题 + "." + 分区号</code> 的命名格式。</p>
<p>ThingsBoard 消息生产者会根据实体 ID 的哈希值决定目标分区，因此同一实体的所有消息始终被写入同一分区。消息消费者通过 ZooKeeper 进行协调，并使用一致性哈希算法确定每个消费者应订阅的分区列表。在微服务模式下，每个服务还会基于唯一服务 ID 拥有专属的 Notifications 主题，该主题仅含单个分区。</p>
<p>ThingsBoard 使用以下 topics：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>tb_transport.api.requests</strong>：传输层向核心服务发送通用 API 请求，用于校验设备凭证。</li>
<li><strong>tb_transport.api.responses</strong>：核心服务向传输层返回设备凭证校验结果。</li>
<li><strong>tb_core</strong>：传输层或规则引擎向核心服务推送消息，包括会话生命周期事件、属性与 RPC 订阅等。</li>
<li><strong>tb_rule_engine</strong>：传输层或核心服务向规则引擎推送消息，包括上报遥测数据、设备状态、实体生命周期事件等。</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="设备的数据">设备的数据</h1>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/attributes/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/attributes/</a></p>
<p>在平台中, 设备的数据主要分为两种 一种是<code>属性</code>, 一种是<code>遥测数据</code> 简而言之:</p>
<ol>
<li><code>遥测数据</code> 是高频变化的设备的实时数据, 时序数据(类似于 Jetlinks 或者阿里云的设备属性)</li>
<li><code>属性</code>主要是为了提高平台的扩展性, 提供额外的元数据给设备, 或者第三方系统读取和写入 (类似于 Jetlinks 或者阿里云的设备标签)</li>
</ol>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>类型</th>
<th>用途</th>
<th>存储</th>
<th>频率</th>
<th>典型数据</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>遥测 Telemetry</strong></td>
<td>实时监测</td>
<td>存历史</td>
<td>高</td>
<td>温度、电压、GPS</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>属性 Attributes</strong></td>
<td>描述 / 配置</td>
<td>只存最新</td>
<td>低</td>
<td>型号、阈值、版本</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="遥测数据">遥测数据</h3>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/telemetry/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/telemetry/</a></p>
<p>For MQTT API - <a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/reference/mqtt-api/#telemetry-upload-api" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/reference/mqtt-api/#telemetry-upload-api</a></p>
<p>ThingsBoard 内部将时间序列数据处理为带时间戳的键值对。我们将单个带时间戳的键值对称为一个<strong>数据点</strong>。这种键值格式的灵活性和简洁性使其能够轻松无缝地与市面上几乎所有物联网设备集成。键始终为字符串，本质上是数据点的键名；而值可以是字符串、布尔值、双精度浮点数、整数或 JSON 格式。</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
// "ts": 1527863043000, 可以不传, 默认使用服务器时间戳
 "temperature": 42.2, 
 "humidity": 70,
 "hvacEnabled": true,
 "hvacState": "IDLE",
 "configuration": {
    "someNumber": 42,
    "someArray": [1,2,3],
    "someNestedObject": {"key": "value"}
 }
}
</code></pre>
<p>内置的各种协议格式 - <a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/reference/mqtt-api/#telemetry-upload-api" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/reference/mqtt-api/#telemetry-upload-api</a></p>
<h3 id="属性数据">属性数据</h3>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/attributes/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/attributes/</a></p>
<p>ThingsBoard supports three types of attributes:&nbsp;<strong>server-side</strong>,&nbsp;<strong>shared</strong>, and&nbsp;<strong>client-side</strong>. Each type has a specific purpose, access rules, and use cases, which we explain below.</p>
<h4 id="客户端属性">客户端属性</h4>
<p>这种类型的属性仅适用于设备。它用于将各种半静态数据从设备（客户端）报告给 ThingsBoard（服务器）。它类似于<a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/attributes/#shared-attributes" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">共享属性</a>，但有一个重要的区别：设备固件/应用程序可以将属性值从设备发送到平台(设备可以修改它)。</p>
<p>客户端属性最常见的用途是报告设备状态。假设我们使用相同的楼宇监控解决方案，并来看几个示例：</p>
<ol>
<li><code>currentFirmwareVersion</code> 属性 可用于向平台报告设备已安装的固件/应用程序版本。</li>
<li><code>currentConfiguration</code>属性 可用于向平台报告当前的固件/应用程序配置。</li>
<li>如果设备没有持久存储，则可以使用 <code>currentState</code> 过网络持久化和恢复当前的固件/应用程序状态。</li>
</ol>
<p>用户端和服务器端应用程序可以通过 UI/REST API 浏览客户端属性，但无法更改这些属性。简而言之，客户端属性的值对于 UI/REST API 来说是只读的。</p>
<p><strong>设备自己上传，服务端只读</strong></p>
<h4 id="共享属性">共享属性</h4>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/attributes/#shared-attributes" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/attributes/#shared-attributes</a><br>
共享属性仅适用于设备类型的实体。其他类型的实体（例如资产或客户）无法使用共享属性。共享属性用于将配置或运行参数（例如: <em>thresholds</em> ）从服务器发送到设备。</p>
<p><strong>设备如何与共享属性交互?</strong><br>
设备无法发布或更改共享属性的值。从设备的角度来看，这些属性是只读的。设备的固件或应用程序可以通过以下方式与共享属性进行交互：</p>
<ul>
<li>请求当前值：设备可以向服务器发送请求，以检索一个或多个共享属性的当前值。</li>
<li>订阅更新：设备可以订阅接收通知，以便在服务器上共享属性的值发生更改时收到通知。</li>
<li><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/integrations/#example" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">通过下行链路接收更新：对于某些网络集成，共享属性更新可以作为下行链路消息</a>推送到设备。</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>服务器下发，设备可读、可订阅</strong></p>
<h4 id="服务属性">服务属性</h4>
<p>几乎所有平台实体都支持此类属性：设备、资产、客户、租户、用户等。服务器端属性是指您可以通过管理界面或 REST API 进行配置的属性。设备固件无法访问服务器端属性。</p>
<p><strong>仅仅平台内部使用，设备不可见, 不可用</strong></p>
<h1 id="平台设备rpc逻辑">平台&lt;&gt;设备(RPC逻辑)</h1>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rpc/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rpc/</a></p>
<p>Server-side RPC feature allows you to send the request&nbsp;<strong>from the platform to the device</strong>&nbsp;and optionally get the response back to the platform.</p>
<p>The typical use cases of the server-side RPC calls is all sorts of remote control: reboot, turn the engine on/off, change state of the gpio/actuators, change configuration parameters, etc.</p>
<p>Server-side RPC is divided into one-way and two-way:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>One-way RPC request does not expect device to provide any reply.<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img.thingsboard.io/user-guide/one-way-rpc.svg" class="lazyload"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Two-way RPC request expects to receive a response from the device within configurable timeout.<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img.thingsboard.io/user-guide/two-way-rpc.svg" class="lazyload"></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Before version 3.3, ThingsBoard supported&nbsp;<strong>lightweight</strong>&nbsp;RPC only. The lightweight RPC calls are short-lived, typically within 30 seconds which is the default timeout of any REST API call to the platform. Since they are short-lived, there was no reason for storing them to the database. They lived in memory of the server, assuming that if server dies, the dashboard widget will send the same request to other ThingsBoard server in the cluster. The lightweight RPC consume low amount of resources since their processing does not invoke any input/output operations accept storing of the audit logs and rule engine messages.</p>
<h3 id="上行">上行</h3>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rpc/#client-side-rpc" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rpc/#client-side-rpc</a></p>
<p>设备向平台发送消息，该消息由<a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rule-engine-2-0/re-getting-started/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">规则引擎</a>处理。规则引擎可能会使用设备属性、遥测数据或平台中存储的任何其他数据进行一些计算。如有需要，规则引擎还可以调用外部系统。消息处理完毕后，结果将发送回设备</p>
<h3 id="下行">下行</h3>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rpc/#server-side-rpc" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rpc/#server-side-rpc</a><br>
平台控制设备（下行）的核心机制是&nbsp;<strong>RPC（远程过程调用）</strong></p>
<p>底层逻辑是</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>指令发出后，会进入<strong>根规则链（Root Rule Chain）</strong>进行处理。</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>消息类型识别</strong>：请求会被封装成一个消息，其类型通常标记为&nbsp;<code>RPC_CALL_FROM_DASHBOARD</code>&nbsp;或类似的 RPC 类型。</li>
<li><strong>节点路由</strong>：
<ul>
<li><strong>消息类型开关</strong>：根规则链通常包含一个“消息类型开关”节点，它根据消息类型将流量分发到不同的子规则链（例如“设备控制链”）。</li>
<li><strong>脚本转换</strong>：在控制链中，通常会使用<strong>脚本节点</strong>来构建具体的控制 payload。你需要在这里编写 JavaScript 代码，定义下发给设备的消息格式（例如&nbsp;<code>{"method": "setPower", "params": {"enabled": true}}</code>）。</li>
<li><strong>RPC 调用节点</strong>：最后，消息会进入一个专门的&nbsp;<strong>RPC 调用节点</strong>。这个节点负责将消息标记为 RPC 请求，并指定目标设备。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>规则引擎处理完毕，消息会被推送到消息队列，随后由&nbsp;<strong>MQTT 传输服务（MQTT Transport）</strong>消费。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>设备处理完成后，必须向平台发送一条响应消息，告知执行结果。(注意: 响应中的&nbsp;<code>{requestId}</code>&nbsp;必须与请求中的一致)</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h4 id="持久化rpc的状态">持久化RPC的状态</h4>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rpc/#persistent-rpc" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rpc/#persistent-rpc</a></p>
<p><strong>States</strong><br>
ThingsBoard tracks state of the persistent RPC. There are 7 available states:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>QUEUED</strong>&nbsp;- RPC was created and saved to the database; No attempt to send the RPC to device yet; ThingsBoard will attempt to send the RPC immediately when device becomes online or if it is already online; The platform will attempt to send all pending RPC calls at once by default. In rare cased of constrained devices and multiple messages in the queue this may lead to overload of the network or device. To avoid the overload, you may enable sequential delivery of RPC calls using “ACTORS_RPC_SEQUENTIAL”&nbsp;<a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/install/config/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">configuration</a>&nbsp;parameter.</li>
<li><strong>SENT</strong>&nbsp;- ThingsBoard performed attempt to send the RPC to device.</li>
<li><strong>DELIVERED</strong>&nbsp;- device confirmed that the RPC was delivered; This is the last step of processing for&nbsp;<strong>one-way</strong>&nbsp;RPC;</li>
<li><strong>SUCCESSFUL</strong>&nbsp;- ThingsBoard received reply for the&nbsp;<strong>two-way</strong>&nbsp;RPC;</li>
<li><strong>TIMEOUT</strong>&nbsp;- ThingsBoard transport layer (MQTT/CoAP/LwM2M, etc) detected timeout of the RPC delivery; The timeout is controlled using one of the corresponding&nbsp;<a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/install/config/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">configuration</a>&nbsp;parameters: MQTT_TIMEOUT (10 seconds by default), COAP_TIMEOUT (10 seconds by default), LWM2M_TIMEOUT (120 seconds by default) By default, platform will not retry delivery of the RPC, and the state will change to FAILED. You may configure number of retries in the RPC body. The maximum number of retries is controlled by “ACTORS_RPC_MAX_RETRIES”&nbsp;<a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/install/config/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">configuration</a>&nbsp;parameter (5 by default).</li>
<li><strong>EXPIRED</strong>&nbsp;- The RPC was not delivered or platform did not receive the reply from device within configured expiration time;</li>
<li><strong>FAILED</strong>&nbsp;- failed to deliver the RPC during configurable number of retries or device firmware does not support such a command.</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="调用链路">调用链路</h4>
<p>向设备发送 RPC 的调用链路</p>
<pre><code class="language-java"> REST API
    │ POST /api/rpc/twoway/{deviceId}
    ▼
  AbstractRpcController                          [tb-core]
    │ ToDeviceRpcRequest
    ▼
  DefaultTbCoreDeviceRpcService
    │ TbMsg(RPC_CALL_FROM_SERVER_TO_DEVICE)
    │ Kafka: tb_rule_engine.*
    ▼
  TbSendRPCRequestNode (规则链节点)             [tb-rule-engine]
    │ RuleEngineDeviceRpcRequest
    ▼
  DefaultTbRuleEngineRpcService
    │ 一致性哈希 → 找到设备所在 Core 节点
    │ Kafka: tb_core  (或本地直接调用)
    ▼
  DeviceActorMessageProcessor#processRpcRequest  [tb-core]
    │ ToTransportMsg
    │ Kafka: tb_transport.notifications.{nodeId}
    ▼
  DefaultTransportService (消费通知 topic)        [tb-transport]
    │ onToDeviceRpcRequest()
    ▼
  MqttTransportHandler
    │ Netty writeAndFlush
    ▼
  设备 (MQTT publish to v1/devices/me/rpc/request/{requestId})
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>RPC 请求必须经过规则引擎，规则链可以在中间做鉴权、过滤、转换</li>
<li>rpcSubscriptions 存储的是设备当前活跃 session 列表，若为空则请求会挂起直到设备上线（pending requests）</li>
<li>originServiceId 贯穿全程，确保响应能路由回发起请求的那个 Core 节点</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="告警系统">告警系统</h1>
<p>设备告警 - <a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/alarms/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/alarms/</a><br>
规则告警 - <a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/alarm-rules/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/alarm-rules/</a></p>
<h3 id="告警状态二元组">告警状态(二元组)</h3>
<p>告警的状态二元组</p>
<p>Together, these dimensions form four possible alarm states:</p>
<ul>
<li><em>Active &amp; Unacknowledged</em></li>
<li><em>Active &amp; Acknowledged</em></li>
<li><em>Cleared &amp; Unacknowledged</em></li>
<li><em>Cleared &amp; Acknowledged</em></li>
</ul>
<p>警报可以由用户手动清除，也可以在规则里条件满足时自动清除(所以有可能是 cleared 但是 unacknown 的状态)。</p>
<h1 id="规则链系统">规则链系统</h1>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rule-engine-2-0/re-getting-started/?scriptfunctionfilterconfig=anonymous" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rule-engine-2-0/re-getting-started/?scriptfunctionfilterconfig=anonymous</a></p>
<p>规则节点总共分为6大类</p>
<h3 id="filter-nodes">Filter nodes</h3>
<p>根据不同条件过滤和路由消息<br>
Filter nodes are the routing and conditional logic components of ThingsBoard’s rule engine that examine messages and determine how they should be routed to downstream nodes based on various criteria.</p>
<h3 id="enrichment-nodes">Enrichment nodes</h3>
<p>利用数据可给节点增加(丰富)元数据信息?<br>
这些节点可以丰富消息的属性、最新的时间序列值、历史时间序列数据以及从各种来源（包括消息发送者、相关实体、当前租户或客户）获取的实体详细信息。</p>
<h3 id="transformation-nodes">Transformation nodes</h3>
<p>修改现有消息或创建新消息<br>
Transformation nodes are the data processing and manipulation(操纵) components of ThingsBoard’s rule engine that modify the content, structure, or format of incoming messages.</p>
<h3 id="action-nodes">Action nodes</h3>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rule-engine-2-0/nodes/action/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rule-engine-2-0/nodes/action/</a></p>
<p>Perform various actions based on configuration and message<br>
根据配置和消息执行各种操作</p>
<ul>
<li>创建警报 — 为消息发送者创建新警报或更新现有的活动警报。</li>
<li>清除警报 — 清除消息发送者现有的活动警报。</li>
<li>计算字段 — 触发时间序列或属性数据的计算字段处理，而不将原始数据持久化到数据库中。</li>
<li>删除关系 — 根据类型和方向，从所选实体到消息发送者的关系中删除关系。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="external-nodes">External nodes</h3>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rule-engine-2-0/nodes/external/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rule-engine-2-0/nodes/external/</a><br>
External nodes are the integration components of ThingsBoard’s rule engine that send messages to third-party services and external systems.</p>
<ul>
<li>AI 请求 — 向大型语言模型发送带有可定制提示和可选文件附件的请求，将 AI 生成的响应作为传出消息数据返回。</li>
<li>MQTT — 使用 QoS 1（至少一次）将传入的消息数据发布到外部 MQTT 代理，支持动态主题模式、多种身份验证方法和 TLS/SSL 加密。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="flow-nodes">Flow nodes</h3>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rule-engine-2-0/nodes/flow/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rule-engine-2-0/nodes/flow/</a></p>
<p>流程节点控制消息如何在规则引擎的不同部分之间移动。 这些节点可以在队列之间传输消息，以实现顺序处理或分离不同的工作负载，将消息转发到其他规则链，并将结果返回给调用规则链。</p>
<ul>
<li>规则链 — 将传入的消息转发到指定的规则链。</li>
<li>检查点 — 将传入的消息转移到指定的队列。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="自定义节点">自定义节点</h2>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/contribution/rule-node-development/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/contribution/rule-node-development/</a></p>
<h3 id="核心概念">核心概念</h3>
<p>在 ThingsBoard 中：</p>
<ul>
<li>每条数据 → 被包装成 <code>TbMsg</code></li>
<li>每个节点 → 处理一条消息</li>
<li>输出 → 发送给下一个节点（带 relation）</li>
</ul>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>ThingsBoard</th>
<th>类比</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Rule Chain</td>
<td>工作流 DAG</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Rule Node</td>
<td>函数节点</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>TbMsg</td>
<td>消息对象</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>relationType</td>
<td>分支条件</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="节点生命周期">节点生命周期</h3>
<pre><code class="language-py">init() → 初始化（解析配置）  
onMsg() → 处理消息（核心写逻辑的地方）  
destroy() → 销毁
</code></pre>
<p><strong>核心逻辑（onMsg）</strong><br>
真正写业务逻辑的地方：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Override  
public void onMsg(TbContext ctx, TbMsg msg) {  
    // 处理 msg  
}
</code></pre>
<p>ThingsBoard 不会自动继续流程，你必须手动：<br>
<code>ctx.tellSuccess(msg);</code><br>
或者：<br>
<code>ctx.tellNext(msg, "True");</code></p>
<h3 id="节点定义rulenode-注解">节点定义（@RuleNode 注解）</h3>
<p>这是“声明元数据”，类似前端组件注册</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RuleNode(  
    type = ComponentType.FILTER,  
    name = "check key",  
    relationTypes = {"True", "False"},  
    configClazz = MyConfig.class  
)
</code></pre>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>字段</th>
<th>本质</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>type</td>
<td>节点分类（影响UI分组）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>name</td>
<td>节点名字</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>relationTypes</td>
<td>输出分支（非常重要）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>configClazz</td>
<td>配置结构</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>configDirective</td>
<td>UI配置（可选）</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>relationTypes = “你这个节点会产生几种出口”<br>
例如：</p>
<ul>
<li>True / False</li>
<li>Success / Failure</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="核心能力">核心能力</h3>
<p>获取输入内容能力</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">msg.getData()       // JSON 数据
msg.getMetadata()   // 元数据
msg.getOriginator() // 来源（设备）
</code></pre>
<p>使用平台能力</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">ctx.getDeviceService()   //设备服务
ctx.getTelemetryService()//遥测数据服务
ctx.getAlarmService()    //告警服务


ctx.getTelemetryService().save(...);
</code></pre>
<p>调用通常是异步的, 所以：</p>
<ul>
<li>不要阻塞,  使用回调</li>
</ul>
<p>同一个设备的数据 → 永远发到同一个节点实例, 所以：</p>
<ul>
<li>可以放心做缓存,  状态管理（按设备）</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="输出消息">输出消息</h3>
<p>生成新消息</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">TbMsg newMsg = TbMsg.transformMsg(msg, newData);  
ctx.tellNext(newMsg, "Success");
</code></pre>
<h3 id="a-sample-project">a sample project</h3>
<p>Clone the repository and navigate to the repo folder:</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">git clone -b release-4.3 https://github.com/thingsboard/rule-node-examples
cd rule-node-examples
</code></pre>
<h1 id="getting-started-with-thingsboard">Getting Started with ThingsBoard</h1>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/getting-started-guides/helloworld/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/getting-started-guides/helloworld/</a></p>
<p>helloworld - 如何接一个设备上去?</p>
<h2 id="step-1-provision-device">Step 1. Provision device</h2>
<p>Let's add a device that sends temperature data to ThingsBoard:</p>
<ul>
<li>Log in to ThingsBoard and navigate to the "Devices" page of the "Entities" section.</li>
<li>Click on the "+" icon in the top right corner of the table and select "Add new device" from drop-down menu.</li>
<li>Enter a device name (e.g., "My New Device") No other changes required at this time. Click "Add".</li>
<li>A window for checking the device connection will open — we'll skip this step for now and return to connection checking in the next step.</li>
<li>Congratulations, you've added your first device! As you add more devices, they will be added at the top of the table, as the table automatically sorts devices by their creation time, with the newest ones listed first.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Additional provisioning methods</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/bulk-provisioning/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Bulk provisioning</a>: Import multiple devices via CSV through the UI.</li>
<li><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/device-provisioning/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Device provisioning</a>: Configure devices to self-register automatically.</li>
<li><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/api/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">REST API</a>&nbsp;provisioning: Manage devices programmatically through APIs.</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="step-2-connect-device">Step 2. Connect device</h2>
<p>Let's verify your device's connection to ThingsBoard:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Click on your device, then click the "Check connectivity” button in the "Device details" window.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>In the opened window, choose your messaging protocol and operating system. Install any necessary client tools and copy the provided command.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Execute the copied command in Terminal. Once telemetry data (e.g., temperature readings) is successfully published, the device status will change from "Inactive" to "Active," and you'll see the data displayed. You can now close the connectivity window.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>接入方式<br>
MQTT 客户端 id 对应 <code>device</code> 表 的 id<br>
MQTT 客户端 username 对应 <code>device_credentials</code> 表的 credentials_id</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>In order to publish telemetry data to ThingsBoard server node, send PUBLISH message to the following topic:</p>
<pre><code>v1/devices/me/telemetry
</code></pre>
<p>The simplest supported data formats are:</p>
<pre><code>{"key1":"value1", "key2":"value2"}
</code></pre>
<p>or</p>
<pre><code>[{"key1":"value1"}, {"key2":"value2"}]
</code></pre>
<p>in case your device is able to get the client-side timestamp, you can use following format:</p>
<pre><code>{"ts":1451649600512, "values":{"key1":"value1", "key2":"value2"}}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="step-3-create-dashboard">Step 3. Create dashboard</h2>
<p>A dashboard in ThingsBoard allows users to visualize and monitor data collected from IoT devices.</p>
<p>Let's create a dashboard and add three widgets to it in order to display a list of entities and their latest values, as well as show alarm signals related to the specified entity.</p>
<h3 id="step-31-create-an-empty-dashboard">Step 3.1 Create an empty dashboard</h3>
<p>To create a new dashboard, follow these steps:</p>
<ul>
<li>Navigate to the "Dashboards" page through the main menu on the left of the screen. Then, click the "+" sign in the upper right corner of the screen, and select "Create new dashboard" from the drop-down menu.</li>
<li>In the opened dialog, it is necessary to enter a dashboard title, description is optional. Click "Add".</li>
<li>After creating the dashboard, it will open automatically, and you can immediately start adding widgets to it. To save the dashboard, click "Save" button in the upper right corner.</li>
<li>Your first dashboard has been successfully created. As you continue to add new dashboards, they will appear at the top of the list. This default sorting is based on the creation timestamp.</li>
</ul>

<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/ota-updates/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/ota-updates/</a></p>

<h1 id="gateway">gateway</h1>
<h2 id="modbus-connector-configuration">Modbus Connector Configuration</h2>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/iot-gateway/config/modbus/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/iot-gateway/config/modbus/</a></p>
<h1 id="服务集群">服务集群</h1>
<h2 id="部署方式">部署方式</h2>
<h5 id="集群节点类型">集群节点类型</h5>
<p>通过 <code>service.type</code> 配置（thingsboard.yml:2078）：</p>
<pre><code>  service:
    type: "${TB_SERVICE_TYPE:monolith}"  # monolith / tb-core / tb-rule-engine
</code></pre>
<ol>
<li>
<p>monolith：单体模式，所有服务在一个进程，队列使用内存实现</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>微服务模式：tb-core、tb-rule-engine、tb-transport 分开部署(共有五个)，通过 Kafka 通信<br>
<code>msa/</code> 目录包含各微服务的独立打包配置</p>
</li>
</ol>

<pre><code class="language-java">@RequiredArgsConstructor  
@Getter  
public enum ServiceType {  
  
    TB_CORE("TB Core"),  
    TB_RULE_ENGINE("TB Rule Engine"),  
    TB_TRANSPORT("TB Transport"),  
    JS_EXECUTOR("JS Executor"),  
    TB_VC_EXECUTOR("TB VC Executor"),  
    EDQS("TB Entity Data Query Service"),  
    TASK_PROCESSOR("Task Processor");  
  
    private final String label;  
  
    public static ServiceType of(String serviceType) {  
        return ServiceType.valueOf(serviceType.replace("-", "_").toUpperCase());  
    }  
  
}

<h3 id="单独消息队列">单独消息队列</h3>
<p>这是核心服务间通信的主干，通过 Protobuf 序列化消息传输。</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml"># Queue configuration parameters  
queue:  
  type: "${TB_QUEUE_TYPE:kafka}" # kafka (Apache Kafka)  
  prefix: "${TB_QUEUE_PREFIX:}" # Global queue prefix. If specified, prefix is added before   
  kafka:  
    # Kafka Bootstrap Servers  
</code></pre>
<p>消息格式（transport.proto）定义了完整的消息体系：</p>
<ul>
<li>ToCoreMsg — 发送给 Core 服务的消息</li>
<li>ToRuleEngineMsg — 发送给规则引擎的消息</li>
<li>ToTransportMsg — 发送给 Transport 服务的消息</li>
<li>TransportApiRequestMsg/ResponseMsg — Transport 与 Core 之间的请求/响应</li>
</ul>
<p>实现类：common/queue/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/queue/kafka/</p>
<ul>
<li>TbKafkaProducerTemplate.java — 生产者</li>
<li>TbKafkaConsumerTemplate.java — 消费者</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="集群的核心逻辑">集群的核心逻辑</h3>
<h4 id="分配设备消息-actor">分配设备消息 Actor</h4>
<p><strong>一致性哈希 (Consistent Hashing)</strong><br>
这是 ThingsBoard 集群的基石。为了确保同一个设备的所有消息都能被同一个“设备 Actor”处理（这对于维护设备状态、避免竞态条件至关重要），ThingsBoard 使用基于设备 ID 的一致性哈希算法。</p>
<p>无论请求到达哪个节点，系统都能通过哈希计算，将消息路由到负责该设备消息的特定节点上进行处理。</p>
<p>关键代码<br>
在&nbsp;<code>HashPartitionService.java</code>&nbsp;中，<code>resolveByPartitionIdx</code>&nbsp;方法如何根据哈希值找到负责该分区的节点：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">// common/cluster-api/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/cluster/HashPartitionService.java

@Override
public ServiceInfo resolveByPartitionIdx(List&lt;ServiceInfo&gt; services, int partitionIdx) {
    // 1. 获取哈希函数 (默认 Murmur3)
    HashFunction hashFunction = this.hashFunction;
    
    // 2. 计算哈希值：将 "分区索引" 作为输入进行哈希
    // 注意：这里利用了分区索引作为种子，确保同一个设备的不同分区请求能路由到同一节点
    int hash = hashFunction.hashInt(partitionIdx);
    
    // 3. 取模运算，找到对应的节点索引
    int index = Math.abs(hash % services.size());
    
    return services.get(index);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="集群异步通信">集群异步通信</h4>
<p><strong>消息队列 (Message Queue)</strong><br>
在微服务架构中，<strong>Apache Kafka</strong>&nbsp;是组件间异步通信的骨干。它负责在各个服务（如传输服务、核心服务、规则引擎）之间传递消息，实现解耦和可扩展性。</p>
<p>ThingsBoard &nbsp;<code>common/queue</code>&nbsp;模块，完全抽象了底层的消息队列实现（支持 Kafka, AWS SQS, Google Pub/Sub, Azure Service Bus 等）。</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>抽象接口</strong>:&nbsp;<code>TbQueueProducer.java</code></li>
<li><strong>Kafka 实现</strong>:&nbsp;<code>TbKafkaProducerTemplate.java</code></li>
</ul>
<h4 id="负载均衡">负载均衡</h4>
<p><strong>分区与负载均衡 (Partitioning &amp; Load Balancing)</strong></p>
<p>ThingsBoard 内部使用“Actor 模型”来处理并发。集群中的每个服务（如&nbsp;<code>TB_CORE</code>,&nbsp;<code>TB_RULE_ENGINE</code>）都有其对应的消息主题和分区。</p>
<ul>
<li><code>PartitionService</code>&nbsp;负责管理这些分区。当一个节点启动时，它会通过&nbsp;<code>DiscoveryService</code>&nbsp;获取集群中所有节点的信息，然后运行&nbsp;<code>recalculatePartitions</code>&nbsp;方法。</li>
<li>该方法会重新计算并分配当前节点应该负责消费哪些主题（如&nbsp;<code>tb_core</code>,&nbsp;<code>tb_rule_engine</code>）的哪些分区（Partition），从而实现消息处理的负载均衡。</li>
</ul>
<p><code>recalculatePartitions</code>&nbsp;方法是集群负载均衡的心脏。它遍历所有配置的队列（如&nbsp;<code>tb_core</code>,&nbsp;<code>tb_rule_engine</code>），计算每个分区应该由谁负责。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">
@Override
public void recalculatePartitions(ServiceInfo currentService, List&lt;ServiceInfo&gt; otherServices) {
    // 1. 合并当前节点和其他节点，形成完整的集群视图
    List&lt;ServiceInfo&gt; allServices = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
    allServices.add(currentService);
    allServices.addAll(otherServices);

    // 2. 按服务类型分组 (例如：所有 tb-core 节点一组，所有 tb-rule-engine 节点一组)
    Map&lt;ServiceQueueKey, List&lt;ServiceInfo&gt;&gt; queueServicesMap = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
    for (ServiceInfo service : allServices) {
        // ... 代码省略：将节点添加到对应的 ServiceQueueKey 列表中
    }

    // 3. 清空旧的分区分配
    myPartitions = new ConcurrentHashMap&lt;&gt;();

    // 4. 遍历所有配置的主题和分区数
    partitionSizes.forEach((serviceQueue, size) -&gt; {
        ServiceQueueKey myServiceQueueKey = new ServiceQueueKey(serviceQueue, myTenantId);
        List&lt;ServiceInfo&gt; services = queueServicesMap.get(myServiceQueueKey);
        
        if (services != null) {
            List&lt;Integer&gt; partitions = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
            // 5. 核心循环：检查每一个分区 (0 到 size-1)
            for (int i = 0; i &lt; size; i++) {
                // 调用一致性哈希算法，计算分区 i 应该由哪个节点负责
                ServiceInfo serviceInfo = resolveByPartitionIdx(services, i);
                
                // 6. 如果负责的节点是当前节点，则将该分区加入“我的分区”列表
                if (serviceInfo.getServiceId().equals(currentService.getServiceId())) {
                    partitions.add(i);
                }
            }
            if (!partitions.isEmpty()) {
                myPartitions.put(myServiceQueueKey, partitions);
            }
        }
    });
    
    // 7. 发布事件，通知消费者服务开始消费这些分区
    publishPartitionChangeEvent();
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="服务信息提供者-defaulttbserviceinfoprovider">服务信息提供者 (<code>DefaultTbServiceInfoProvider</code>)</h4>
<p>这个类负责在启动时构建当前节点的服务信息，包括服务ID、服务类型等。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">
@PostConstruct
public void init() {
    // 1. 获取本机 HostName 作为 serviceId
    if (StringUtils.isEmpty(serviceId)) {
        serviceId = InetAddress.getLocalHost().getHostName();
    }
    
    // 2. 确定服务类型。如果是 "monolith" (单体模式)，则包含所有服务类型
    if (serviceType.equalsIgnoreCase("monolith")) {
        serviceTypes = Collections.unmodifiableList(Arrays.asList(ServiceType.values()));
    } else {
        serviceTypes = Collections.singletonList(ServiceType.of(serviceType));
    }

    // 3. 构建 ServiceInfo 对象，用于向集群注册
    ServiceInfo.Builder builder = ServiceInfo.newBuilder()
        .setServiceId(serviceId)
        .addAllServiceTypes(serviceTypes.stream().map(ServiceType::name).collect(Collectors.toList()));
    // ... 设置租户ID等其他信息
    serviceInfo = builder.build();
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="分区服务-hashpartitionservice">分区服务 (HashPartitionService)</h4>
<p>这个服务负责根据配置管理各个服务队列的主题和分区数量。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">// HashPartitionService.java 中的 init() 方法
@PostConstruct
public void init() {
    // 1. 初始化哈希函数，默认为 murmur3_128
    this.hashFunction = forName(hashFunctionName);
    
    // 2. 配置核心服务 (TB_CORE) 的主题和分区数
    partitionSizes.put(new ServiceQueue(ServiceType.TB_CORE), corePartitions); // 默认10个分区
    partitionTopics.put(new ServiceQueue(ServiceType.TB_CORE), coreTopic);     // 默认 "tb_core"

    // 3. 配置规则引擎服务 (TB_RULE_ENGINE) 的主题和分区数
    tbQueueRuleEngineSettings.getQueues().forEach(queueConfiguration -&gt; {
        partitionTopics.put(
            new ServiceQueue(ServiceType.TB_RULE_ENGINE, queueConfiguration.getName()), 
            queueConfiguration.getTopic()
        );
        partitionSizes.put(
            new ServiceQueue(ServiceType.TB_RULE_ENGINE, queueConfiguration.getName()), 
            queueConfiguration.getPartitions()
        );
    });
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="服务发现与分区重算-dummydiscoveryservice">服务发现与分区重算 (<code>DummyDiscoveryService</code>)</h4>
<p>这个类展示了当应用准备就绪时，如何触发分区重新计算。这里是&nbsp;<code>DummyDiscoveryService</code>&nbsp;的实现，它不包含其他节点信息。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">// DummyDiscoveryService.java
// 在收到 Spring 的 ApplicationReadyEvent 事件后触发
public void onApplicationEvent(ApplicationReadyEvent event) {
    // 调用分区重算方法
    partitionService.recalculatePartitions(currentServiceInfo, Collections.emptyList());
}

// 在真正的 Zookeeper 实现 (ZkDiscoveryService) 中，
// 会监听 Zookeeper 节点变化，并在变化时调用 recalculatePartitions，
// 并传入所有其他服务节点的信息列表 (otherServices)。
</code></pre>
<h4 id="分区重算核心逻辑-recalculatepartitions">分区重算核心逻辑 (<code>recalculatePartitions</code>)</h4>
<p>这是集群协调的核心，决定了当前节点负责处理哪些消息分区。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">// PartitionService.java 中的 recalculatePartitions 方法
public void recalculatePartitions(ServiceInfo currentService, List&lt;ServiceInfo&gt; otherServices) {
    // 1. 将所有节点（当前节点+其他节点）按服务队列类型分组
    Map&lt;ServiceQueueKey, List&lt;ServiceInfo&gt;&gt; queueServicesMap = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
    addNode(queueServicesMap, currentService);
    for (ServiceInfo other : otherServices) {
        addNode(queueServicesMap, other);
    }

    // 2. 清空旧的分区分配
    myPartitions = new ConcurrentHashMap&lt;&gt;();

    // 3. 为当前服务分配分区
    partitionSizes.forEach((serviceQueue, size) -&gt; {
        ServiceQueueKey myServiceQueueKey = new ServiceQueueKey(serviceQueue, myTenantId);
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; size; i++) {
            // 核心：通过一致性哈希，根据分区索引 i 找到负责该分区的节点
            ServiceInfo serviceInfo = resolveByPartitionIdx(queueServicesMap.get(myServiceQueueKey), i);
            
            // 如果负责的节点是当前节点，则将该分区加入 myPartitions
            if (serviceInfo.getServiceId().equals(currentService.getServiceId())) {
                myPartitions.computeIfAbsent(myServiceQueueKey, key -&gt; new ArrayList&lt;&gt;()).add(i);
            }
        }
    });

    // 4. 对比新旧分区分配，如果有变化，则发布 PartitionChangeEvent 事件，
    // 通知消费者服务开始或停止消费相应的 Kafka 分区。
    // ...
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="注册中心是-zookeeper">注册中心是 Zookeeper</h3>
<p><code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.discovery.ZkDiscoveryService</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public interface DiscoveryService {
    // 获取所有其他服务的节点信息
    List&lt;ServiceInfo&gt; getOtherServices();
    
    // 获取当前服务自身的信息
    ServiceInfo getCurrentService();
}
</code></pre>
<p>在<code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.discovery.ZkDiscoveryService#publishCurrentServer</code>中，服务注册的核心逻辑：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">
public synchronized void publishCurrentServer() {
    TransportProtos.ServiceInfo self = serviceInfoProvider.getServiceInfo();
    if (currentServerExists()) {
        // 更新现有节点
        client.setData().forPath(nodePath, serviceInfoProvider.generateNewServiceInfoWithCurrentSystemInfo().toByteArray());
    } else {
        // 创建新节点
        nodePath = client.create()
                .creatingParentsIfNeeded()
                .withMode(CreateMode.EPHEMERAL_SEQUENTIAL)
                .forPath(zkNodesDir + "/", self.toByteArray());
    }

</code></pre>
<p>从连机制<br>
<code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.discovery.ZkDiscoveryService#reconnect</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java"> private synchronized void reconnect() {
        if (!reconnectInProgress) {
            reconnectInProgress = true;
            try {
                destroyZkClient();
                initZkClient();
                subscribeToEvents();
                publishCurrentServer();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("Failed to reconnect to ZK: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
            } finally {
                reconnectInProgress = false;
            }
        }
    }
</code></pre>

<h1 id="源码分析">源码分析</h1>
<h2 id="一个设备消息的处理过程mqtt">一个设备消息的处理过程(MQTT)</h2>
<p>以MQTT协议为例, 源码版本是:  <code>&lt;version&gt;4.3.1.1&lt;/version&gt;</code></p>
<p>启动入口模块是 <code>transport/mqtt</code> 基于Spring 体系的<code>@PostConstruct</code> 注解<br>
源码逻辑入口模块是: <code>common/transport/mqtt</code> 初始化类是: <code>org.thingsboard.server.transport.mqtt.MqttTransportService</code></p>
<blockquote>
<p>底层其实是 Netty..</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Service("MqttTransportService")
@TbMqttTransportComponent
@Slf4j
public class MqttTransportService implements TbTransportService {

    public static AttributeKey&lt;InetSocketAddress&gt; ADDRESS = AttributeKey.newInstance("SRC_ADDRESS");

    @Value("${transport.mqtt.bind_address}")
    private String host;
    @Value("${transport.mqtt.bind_port}")
    private Integer port;

    @Value("${transport.mqtt.ssl.enabled}")
    private boolean sslEnabled;

    @Value("${transport.mqtt.ssl.bind_address}")
    private String sslHost;
    @Value("${transport.mqtt.ssl.bind_port}")
    private Integer sslPort;

    @Value("${transport.mqtt.netty.leak_detector_level}")
    private String leakDetectorLevel;
    @Value("${transport.mqtt.netty.boss_group_thread_count}")
    private Integer bossGroupThreadCount;
    @Value("${transport.mqtt.netty.worker_group_thread_count}")
    private Integer workerGroupThreadCount;
    @Value("${transport.mqtt.netty.so_keep_alive}")
    private boolean keepAlive;

    @Autowired
    private MqttTransportContext context;

    private Channel serverChannel;
    private Channel sslServerChannel;
    private EventLoopGroup bossGroup;
    private EventLoopGroup workerGroup;

    @PostConstruct
    public void init() throws Exception {
        log.info("Setting resource leak detector level to {}", leakDetectorLevel);
        ResourceLeakDetector.setLevel(ResourceLeakDetector.Level.valueOf(leakDetectorLevel.toUpperCase()));

        log.info("Starting MQTT transport...");
        bossGroup = new NioEventLoopGroup(bossGroupThreadCount);
        workerGroup = new NioEventLoopGroup(workerGroupThreadCount);
        ServerBootstrap b = new ServerBootstrap();
        b.group(bossGroup, workerGroup)
                .channel(NioServerSocketChannel.class)
                .childHandler(new MqttTransportServerInitializer(context, false))
                .childOption(ChannelOption.SO_KEEPALIVE, keepAlive);

        serverChannel = b.bind(host, port).sync().channel();
        if (sslEnabled) {
            b = new ServerBootstrap();
            b.group(bossGroup, workerGroup)
                    .channel(NioServerSocketChannel.class)
                    .childHandler(new MqttTransportServerInitializer(context, true))
                    .childOption(ChannelOption.SO_KEEPALIVE, keepAlive);
            sslServerChannel = b.bind(sslHost, sslPort).sync().channel();
        }
        log.info("Mqtt transport started!");
    }
    ...........
</code></pre>
<h4 id="消息处理入口-processmqttmsg">消息处理入口 (<code>processMqttMsg</code>)</h4>
<p><code>org.thingsboard.server.transport.mqtt.MqttTransportHandler#processMqttMsg</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">void processMqttMsg(ChannelHandlerContext ctx, MqttMessage msg) {
    // 检查消息头
    if (msg.fixedHeader() == null) {
        closeCtx(ctx, MqttReasonCodes.Disconnect.PROTOCOL_ERROR);
        return;
    }
    deviceSessionCtx.setChannel(ctx);

    // 判断消息类型
    if (CONNECT.equals(msg.fixedHeader().messageType())) {
        processConnect(ctx, (MqttConnectMessage) msg);  // 处理连接
    } else if (deviceSessionCtx.isProvisionOnly()) {
        processProvisionSessionMsg(ctx, msg);           // 处理预注册消息
    } else {
        enqueueRegularSessionMsg(ctx, msg);             // 入队处理常规消息
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="常规会话消息处理-processregularsessionmsg">常规会话消息处理 (<code>processRegularSessionMsg</code>)</h4>
<pre><code class="language-java">void processRegularSessionMsg(ChannelHandlerContext ctx, MqttMessage msg) {
    switch (msg.fixedHeader().messageType()) {
        case PUBLISH:
            processPublish(ctx, (MqttPublishMessage) msg);    // 处理发布消息
            break;
        case SUBSCRIBE:
            processSubscribe(ctx, (MqttSubscribeMessage) msg);  // 处理订阅
            break;
        case PINGREQ:
            // 处理心跳
            ctx.writeAndFlush(new MqttMessage(new MqttFixedHeader(PINGRESP, ...)));
            transportService.recordActivity(deviceSessionCtx.getSessionInfo());
            break;
        case DISCONNECT:
            closeCtx(ctx, MqttReasonCodes.Disconnect.NORMAL_DISCONNECT);
            break;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="设备发布消息处理-processdevicepublish">设备发布消息处理 (<code>processDevicePublish</code>)</h4>
<pre><code class="language-java">private void processDevicePublish(ChannelHandlerContext ctx, MqttPublishMessage mqttMsg, String topicName, int msgId) {
    MqttTransportAdaptor payloadAdaptor = deviceSessionCtx.getPayloadAdaptor();

    // 处理设备属性消息
    if (deviceSessionCtx.isDeviceAttributesTopic(topicName)) {
        TransportProtos.PostAttributeMsg postAttributeMsg = payloadAdaptor.convertToPostAttributes(deviceSessionCtx, mqttMsg);
        transportService.process(deviceSessionCtx.getSessionInfo(), postAttributeMsg, ...);
    }
    // 处理设备遥测数据
    else if (deviceSessionCtx.isDeviceTelemetryTopic(topicName)) {
        TransportProtos.PostTelemetryMsg postTelemetryMsg = payloadAdaptor.convertToPostTelemetry(deviceSessionCtx, mqttMsg);
        transportService.process(deviceSessionCtx.getSessionInfo(), postTelemetryMsg, ...);
    }
    // 处理属性请求
    else if (topicName.startsWith(MqttTopics.DEVICE_ATTRIBUTES_REQUEST_TOPIC_PREFIX)) {
        TransportProtos.GetAttributeRequestMsg getAttributeMsg = payloadAdaptor.convertToGetAttributes(...);
        transportService.process(deviceSessionCtx.getSessionInfo(), getAttributeMsg, ...);
    }
    // 处理RPC相关消息
    // ...
}

</code></pre>
<h4 id="遥测数据处理-process">遥测数据处理 (<code>process</code>)</h4>
<pre><code class="language-java">public void process(TransportProtos.SessionInfoProto sessionInfo, TransportProtos.PostTelemetryMsg msg,
                   TbMsgMetaData md, TransportServiceCallback&lt;Void&gt; callback) {
    // 计算数据点数量
    int dataPoints = 0;
    for (TransportProtos.TsKvListProto tsKv : msg.getTsKvListList()) {
        dataPoints += tsKv.getKvCount();
    }

    // 限流检查
    if (checkLimits(sessionInfo, msg, callback, dataPoints)) {
        recordActivityInternal(sessionInfo);

        // 提取会话信息
        TenantId tenantId = getTenantId(sessionInfo);
        DeviceId deviceId = new DeviceId(new UUID(sessionInfo.getDeviceIdMSB(), sessionInfo.getDeviceIdLSB()));
        CustomerId customerId = getCustomerId(sessionInfo);

        // 处理每条时间序列数据
        MsgPackCallback packCallback = new MsgPackCallback(...);
        for (TransportProtos.TsKvListProto tsKv : msg.getTsKvListList()) {
            // 构建元数据
            TbMsgMetaData metaData = md != null ? md.copy() : new TbMsgMetaData();
            metaData.putValue("deviceName", sessionInfo.getDeviceName());
            metaData.putValue("deviceType", sessionInfo.getDeviceType());
            metaData.putValue("ts", tsKv.getTs() + "");

            // 转换为JSON对象
            JsonObject json = JsonUtils.getJsonObject(tsKv.getKvList());

            // 发送到规则引擎
            sendToRuleEngine(tenantId, deviceId, customerId, sessionInfo, json, metaData,
                           TbMsgType.POST_TELEMETRY_REQUEST, packCallback);
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="发送到规则引擎-sendtoruleengine">发送到规则引擎 (<code>sendToRuleEngine</code>)</h4>
<pre><code class="language-java">private void sendToRuleEngine(TenantId tenantId, DeviceId deviceId, CustomerId customerId,
                              TransportProtos.SessionInfoProto sessionInfo, JsonObject json,
                              TbMsgMetaData metaData, TbMsgType tbMsgType, TbQueueCallback callback) {
    // 获取设备配置
    DeviceProfileId deviceProfileId = new DeviceProfileId(...);
    DeviceProfile deviceProfile = deviceProfileCache.get(deviceProfileId);
    RuleChainId ruleChainId;
    String queueName;

    if (deviceProfile == null) {
        ruleChainId = null;
        queueName = null;
    } else {
        ruleChainId = deviceProfile.getDefaultRuleChainId();  // 获取默认规则链ID
        queueName = deviceProfile.getDefaultQueueName();      // 获取默认队列名称
    }

    // 构建TbMsg消息对象
    TbMsg tbMsg = TbMsg.newMsg()
            .queueName(queueName)
            .type(tbMsgType)
            .originator(deviceId)
            .customerId(customerId)
            .copyMetaData(metaData)
            .data(gson.toJson(json))
            .ruleChainId(ruleChainId)
            .build();

    // 发送到规则引擎
    ruleEngineProducerService.sendToRuleEngine(ruleEngineMsgProducer, tenantId, tbMsg, new StatsCallback(callback, ruleEngineProducerStats));
	
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.common.TbRuleEngineProducerService</code></p>
<h4 id="队列路由router">队列路由(Router)</h4>
<p>单体是 <code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.memory.InMemoryTbQueueProducer#send</code> 在内存路由<br>
集群是 <code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.kafka.TbKafkaProducerTemplate#send</code> 到kafak去</p>

<h2 id="离线判定">离线判定</h2>
<p>触发离线的完整流程</p>
<ol>
<li>定时轮询（DefaultDeviceStateService.java）</li>
</ol>
<p><code>org.thingsboard.server.service.state.DefaultDeviceStateService#init</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">  // 服务启动时注册，每 60 秒执行一次
  scheduledExecutor.scheduleWithFixedDelay(
      this::checkStates,
      new Random().nextInt(defaultStateCheckIntervalInSec),  // 随机初始延迟，避免集群雪崩
      defaultStateCheckIntervalInSec,
      TimeUnit.SECONDS
  );
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>判断每个设备（updateInactivityStateIfExpired）</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-java">  // 同时满足以下 3 个条件才触发离线：
  if (!isActive(ts, state)                                           // 1. 超过 inactivityTimeout 未活跃
      &amp;&amp; (state.getLastInactivityAlarmTime() == 0L                   // 2. 之前没报过离线
          || state.getLastInactivityAlarmTime() &lt;= state.getLastActivityTime()) // 或者离线后又活跃过
      &amp;&amp; stateData.getDeviceCreationTime() + state.getInactivityTimeout() &lt;= ts) { // 3. 设备创建时间也满足（防止新设备误判）
      reportInactivity(ts, stateData);
  }
</code></pre>
<ol start="3">
<li>触发离线事件<br>
<code>org.thingsboard.server.service.state.DefaultDeviceStateService#onDeviceActivityStatusChange</code></li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-java">// reportInactivity → onDeviceActivityStatusChange(false, ...) // 丢到集群消息队列去
pushRuleEngineMessage(stateData, TbMsgType.INACTIVITY_EVENT);
</code></pre>
<p>同时保存 active=false 到属性/时序，并触发通知规则, 活跃时间的来源（何时更新 lastActivityTime）<br>
设备以下任何行为都会刷新 lastActivityTime：</p>
<ol start="4">
<li>关键配置</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-yaml"># Device state parameters
state:
  # Device inactivity timeout is a global configuration parameter that defines when the device will be marked as "inactive" by the server.
  # The parameter value is in seconds. A user can overwrite this parameter for an individual device by setting the “inactivityTimeout” server-side attribute (NOTE: expects value in milliseconds).
  # We recommend this parameter to be in sync with session inactivity timeout ("transport.sessions.inactivity_timeout" or TB_TRANSPORT_SESSIONS_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT) parameter
  # which is responsible for detection of the stale device connection sessions.
  # The value of the session inactivity timeout parameter should be greater or equal to the device inactivity timeout.
  # Note that the session inactivity timeout is set in milliseconds while device inactivity timeout is in seconds.
  defaultInactivityTimeoutInSec: "${DEFAULT_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT:600}"
  defaultStateCheckIntervalInSec: "${DEFAULT_STATE_CHECK_INTERVAL:60}" # Interval for checking the device state after a specified period. Time in seconds
</code></pre>
<h1 id="组件配置参数">组件配置参数</h1>
<p><a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/install/how-to-change-config/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/install/how-to-change-config/</a><br>
<a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/install/http-transport-config/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/install/http-transport-config/</a></p>
<h2 id="sqlnosql-混合数据库配置">SQL、NoSQL 混合数据库配置</h2>
<p>ThingsBoard 使用数据库来存储&nbsp;<a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/entities-and-relations/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">实体</a>（设备、资产、客户、仪表盘等）和&nbsp;<a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/telemetry/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">遥测</a>数据（属性、时间序列传感器读数、统计数据、事件）。平台目前支持三种数据库选项：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>SQL</strong>&nbsp;- 将所有实体和遥测数据存储在 SQL 数据库中。ThingsBoard 的开发者建议使用 PostgreSQL，这也是 ThingsBoard 支持的主流 SQL 数据库。HSQLDB 可用于本地开发。<strong>我们不建议将 HSQLDB 用于</strong>除运行测试和启动负载尽可能低的开发实例之外的任何用途。</li>
<li><strong>混合型（PostgreSQL + Cassandra）</strong>&nbsp;- 将所有实体存储在 PostgreSQL 数据库中，并将时间序列数据存储在 Cassandra 数据库中。</li>
<li><strong>混合型（PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB）</strong>&nbsp;- 将所有实体存储在 PostgreSQL 数据库中，并将时间序列数据存储在 Timescale 数据库中。<br>
可以使用 <strong>thingsboard.yml</strong> 文件配置这些选项。更多详情请参阅数据库<a href="https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/install/config/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">配置页面。</a></li>
</ul>

<td>Session inactivity timeout is a global configuration parameter that defines how long the device transport session will be opened after the last message arrives from the device. The parameter value is in milliseconds. The last activity time of the device session is updated if the device sends any message, including keepalive messages If there is no activity, the session will be closed, and all subscriptions will be deleted. We recommend this parameter to be in sync with device inactivity timeout ("state.defaultInactivityTimeoutInSec" or DEFAULT_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT) parameter which is responsible for detection of the device connectivity status in the core service of the platform. The value of the session inactivity timeout parameter should be greater or equal to the device inactivity timeout. Note that the session inactivity timeout is set in milliseconds while device inactivity timeout is in seconds.</td>
